description_en: Queries a list of Alibaba Cloud Kubernetes container service (ACK) clusters that meet specified conditions, such as cluster type and specifications
description_zh: 查询阿里云K8S容器服务（ACK）集群，查询符合条件的ACK集群（例如指定集群类型、集群规格）列表信息
name: DescribeAckClusters

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the ACK cluster
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the account to which the ACK cluster resources belong
parameters.help_zh: ACK集群资源所属的阿里云UID
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：每页显示条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ACK cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the ACK cluster
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The specifications of the ACK cluster
parameters.name: cluster_spec

parameters.help_en: The status of the connector instance for the ACK cluster
parameters.name: connector_status

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the ACK cluster

ClusterName.description_en: The name of the ACK cluster

ClusterSpec.description_en: The specifications of the ACK cluster

ClusterType.description_en:
The type of the ACK cluster. Valid values:
ManagedKubernetes: ACK managed clusters, including ACK managed clusters (Pro Edition and Basic Edition), ACK Serverless clusters (Pro Edition and Basic Edition), ACK Edge clusters (Pro Edition and Basic Edition), and ACK Lingjun clusters (Pro Edition).
ExternalKubernetes: registered cluster
Kubernetes: ACK dedicated cluster
ClusterType.description_zh:
ACK集群类型。取值：
ManagedKubernetes：ACK 托管类的集群，包括 ACK 托管集群（Pro 版、基础版）、ACK Serverless 集群（Pro 版、基础版）、ACK Edge 集群（Pro 版、基础版）、ACK 灵骏集群（Pro 版）。
ExternalKubernetes：注册集群。
Kubernetes：ACK 专有集群

enumValueTitles.ManagedKubernetes: ACK 托管类的集群，包括 ACK 托管集群（Pro 版、基础版）、ACK Serverless 集群（Pro 版、基础版）、ACK Edge 集群（Pro 版、基础版）、ACK 灵骏集群（Pro 版）。

MemberUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the account to which the ACK cluster resources belong
MemberUid.description_zh: ACK集群资源所属的阿里云UID

Network.description_en:
The network plug-in of the ACK cluster. Valid values:
terway-eniip: terway-eniip network plug-in
Flannel: flannel network plug-in
Network.description_zh:
ACK集群网络插件。取值：
terway-eniip：Terway-eniip 网络插件。
Flannel：Flannel 网络插件

Profile.description_en:
The subtype of the cluster. This parameter is valid only when ClusterType is set to ManagedKubernetes (ACK managed clusters). Valid values:
Default: ACK managed cluster, including ACK managed cluster Pro Edition and Basic Edition
Serverless: ACK Serverless cluster, including ACK Serverless cluster Pro Edition and Basic Edition
Edge: ACK Edge cluster, including ACK Edge cluster Pro Edition and Basic Edition
Lingjun: ACK Lingjun cluster, which provides only the Pro Edition
Profile.description_zh:
当`ClusterType`取值为`ManagedKubernetes`（ACK 托管类集群）时，该参数表示集群的子类型。取值：
Default：ACK 托管集群，包括 ACK 集群 Pro 版和 ACK 集群基础版。
Serverless：ACK Serverless 集群，包括 ACK Serverless 集群 Pro 版和 ACK Serverless 集群基础版。
Edge：ACK Edge 集群，包括 ACK Edge 集群 Pro 版和 ACK Edge 集群基础版。
Lingjun：ACK 灵骏集群，提供 Pro 版

enumValueTitles.Default: ACK 托管集群，包括 ACK 集群 Pro 版和 ACK 集群基础版。
enumValueTitles.Edge: ACK Edge 集群，包括 ACK Edge 集群 Pro 版和 ACK Edge 集群基础版。
enumValueTitles.Lingjun: ACK 灵骏集群，提供 Pro 版。
enumValueTitles.Serverless: ACK Serverless 集群，包括 ACK Serverless 集群 Pro 版和 ACK Serverless 集群基础版。

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the ACK cluster

State.description_en:
The running status of the ACK cluster. Valid values:
initial: The cluster is being created.
running: The cluster is running.
scaling: The cluster is being scaled.
stopped: The cluster is stopped.
upgrading: The cluster is being upgraded.
updating: The cluster configurations are being updated.
deleting: The cluster is being deleted.
deleted: The cluster is deleted.
draining: Nodes are being drained.
removing: Nodes are being removed.
failed: The cluster failed to be created.
delete_failed: The cluster failed to be deleted
State.description_zh:
ACK集群运行状态。取值：
initial：集群创建中
running：集群运行中
scaling：集群伸缩中
stopped：集群已经停止运行
upgrading：集群升级中
updating：集群配置变更中
deleting：集群删除中
deleted：集群已经被删除
draining：节点排水中
removing：节点移除中
failed：集群创建失败
delete_failed：集群删除失败

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the ACK cluster belongs

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页参数：每页显示条数
